sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Actual_Order_Products"."actual_order_id" AS e, "Customers"."payment_method" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "Actual_Order_Products" JOIN "Actual_Orders" ON "Actual_Orders"."actual_order_id" = "Actual_Order_Products"."actual_order_id" JOIN "Regular_Orders" ON "Regular_Orders"."regular_order_id" = "Actual_Orders"."regular_order_id" JOIN "Customers" ON "Customers"."customer_id" = "Regular_Orders"."distributer_id" GROUP BY "Actual_Order_Products"."actual_order_id", "Customers"."payment_method"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: share of the all total of number of Actual_Order_Products records (all level)
rank within the group by number of Actual_Order_Products records, keep the top 3
